name: jobscout
description: Build a reusable job-search profile, find and verify current public listings, rank matches, and save dated shortlists locally. No login and no auto-apply.

interface.shortDescription: Reusable private job-search profiles, verified public listings, and dated ranked shortlists saved locally.
interface.longDescription: Set up a reusable job-search profile, then find, verify, rank, and save current public work opportunities — full-time, contract, or freelance. Use when the user wants to configure their job search, build a Jobscout profile from a resume and preferences, find jobs or contract/freelance gigs that match their profile, run a new job search, or save a ranked shortlist of verified openings.
defaultPrompt: Find and verify current jobs that match my profile.
Run a new job search and save the results.
